title: Weak Password Policy Enforcement
description:
The registration endpoint (/api/register.php) accepts extremely weak passwords with no complexity requirements implemented. The application accepts:
- Single character passwords (e.g., "1", "a")
- Empty passwords (null/blank values)
- Numeric-only passwords
- Passwords with only 2 characters

There is no validation for minimum password length, character diversity requirements (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters), or blacklisting of common weak passwords. All weak password submissions return HTTP 200 with "Registration successful" message, indicating complete acceptance without validation.
impact:
Users can create accounts with minimal or no password protection, significantly compromising account security. This allows:
- Trivial brute force attacks due to extremely short password space
- Account compromise with minimal effort
- Violation of security best practices and compliance standards (CIS, NIST, PCI-DSS)
- Complete undermining of account authentication security posture
references: CWE-521: Weak Password Requirements, OWASP A07:2021 - Identification and Authentication Failures, NIST SP 800-63B: Authentication and Lifecycle Management, CIS Benchmarks - Access Control
toolCallDescription: Document weak password policy enforcement finding with verified POC
